## 📋 Task breakdown ready — `specs/001-bookmark-manager/tasks.md`

**81 tasks (T001–T081)** across 16 phases, organized so each user story is an independently shippable increment.

### Per-phase breakdown

| Phase | Scope | Tasks |
|---|---|---|
| 1 — Setup | Repo structure, workspaces, toolchain | T001–T005 (5) |
| 2 — Foundational ⚠️ | DB schema + FTS, server, base models, frontend shell, `app.json` | T006–T016 (11) |
| 3 — **US1** 🎯 | Save + auto-enrich; edit all 5 fields | T017–T024 (8) |
| 4 — **US2** | No duplicates → route to existing | T025–T028 (4) |
| 5 — **US3** | Browse, sort, open | T029–T032 (4) |
| 6 — **US4** | Advanced boolean search | T033–T039 (7) |
| 7 — US5 | Read-later (not auto-unread) | T040–T043 (4) |
| 8 — US6 | Tags + type-ahead suggestions | T044–T048 (5) |
| 9 — US7 | Markdown notes (sanitized) | T049–T051 (3) |
| 10 — US8 | Bulk & view-wide actions | T052–T054 (3) |
| 11 — US9 | Archive vs delete | T055–T058 (4) |
| 12 — US10 | Saved views | T059–T061 (3) |
| 13 — US11 | Import/export | T062–T066 (5) |
| 14 — US12 | Self-contained snapshots + Internet Archive (visible outcomes) | T067–T071 (5) |
| 15 — US13 | Display preferences | T072–T075 (4) |
| 16 — Polish | Perf @5k, safe-render audit, quickstart validation | T076–T081 (6) |

### How it's sequenced
- **MVP = Phases 1–6** (US1–US4, all P1): save+enrich → no-duplicate → browse/sort/open → search. That's a genuinely usable product; stop and validate there.
- Then **P2** (US5–US9), then **P3** (US10–US13). Each story has its own tests + checkpoint.

### Tests included (per approved plan)
- **Unit (`vitest`)**: URL normalization, search parser (all grammar edge cases incl. implicit-AND, case-insensitive operators, quoted-operator-as-text), import/export mapping.
- **E2E (Playwright 1.61.0)**: one scenario file per story, tracing spec acceptance scenarios. The US12 test explicitly checks the snapshot renders **offline with the origin blocked** and that failures show a **visible `failed` state**.

### Parallelization
`[P]`-marked tasks touch separate files (e.g. backend service vs. frontend component). After Foundational, the P2/P3 stories are independent and can be built in parallel.

**Format check**: every task uses `- [ ] Txxx [P?] [USn?] description + file path` ✅

---

Per this project's gated SDD workflow, the last step — `speckit-implement` — actually writes the code. Spec and plan are both approved, so I'm clear to proceed.

Would you like me to:
1. **Implement the full breakdown**, or
2. **Implement the MVP slice first** (Phases 1–6 / US1–US4), stop, and let you review a running app before continuing to P2/P3?

I'd recommend option 2 for a feature this size — you get a working, reviewable app sooner. Which would you prefer?
